name: Broodmother Lysrix
location: Summon The Center Arena at an Obelisk; Broodmother and Megapithecus appear together. The three ASA terminal locations are listed below.
summary: One of the two guardians in The Center Arena fight; this is not a separate fight as it is on The Island.
strategy: Suggested team: Rex or Therizino with Yutyrannus; consider Megatherium to handle the spiders. Prepare for the pressure of fighting two bosses together.
Keep the team together and pull each boss separately when terrain allows; manage minions, thrown rocks, and spiders.
Check the limit of 20 tames / 10 survivors, the creature whitelist, and the timer; do not assume flyers or oversized tames can enter.
rewardsNote: Both guardians must be defeated. The arena wiki lists total Element for Gamma/Beta/Alpha as 72/200/442; the Element page lists Gamma as 92. Gamma remains unconfirmed because the two sources conflict; check the loot in game. Trophies/flags and Tekgrams depend on difficulty; there is no The Island ascension.
kit: Required artifacts / trophies and tributes for the chosen difficulty
Bred and imprinted tames with checked saddles
Fully healed team with enough food
Check the portal, tame limits, and timer in your save
